evidence_summary: Surveyed employers in the Future of Jobs Report 2025 expect the networks and cybersecurity skill category to increase in importance during 2025-2030. The cybersecurity label is explicitly part of the reported category; this is an employer-expectations forecast, not an observed Malaysian hiring series.
source_name: World Economic Forum - The Future of Jobs Report 2025: Chapter 3 Skills outlook
interpretation_limitations: Section 3.2: Skill evolution and Core skills in 2030. Global surveyed employers across industries; not a Malaysia-specific forecast or a measured vacancy count. Source combines networks and cybersecurity and does not establish demand for every security subskill or tool. Verified means the reported forecast was checked; it does not verify the linked candidate role or predict an individual employment outcome.

evidence_summary: The Future of Jobs Report 2025 identifies analytical thinking among the skills employers expect to rise in importance by 2030. This is a direct finding about analytical thinking; it is not treated as evidence for SQL, Python, statistics or any other narrower skill.
source_name: World Economic Forum - The Future of Jobs Report 2025: Chapter 3 Skills outlook
interpretation_limitations: Section 3.2: Skill evolution and Core skills in 2030. Global cross-occupation employer expectations for 2025-2030; not Malaysian or Data Analyst-specific observed hiring. The role link supplies context only. Analytical Thinking is an existing canonical label but is not being added to this role's required_skills or skill_weights; the role remains unverified.

evidence_summary: The report's industry findings differ for the design and user experience skill category: advanced-manufacturing employers anticipate increasing demand, while a larger share of IT-services employers foresee declines than in other industries. These contrasting sector signals do not establish one overall direction for UI/UX design.
source_name: World Economic Forum - The Future of Jobs Report 2025: Chapter 5 Region economy and industry insights
interpretation_limitations: Section 5.2: Advanced Manufacturing and Information and Technology Services. Global industry forecasts for 2025-2030; not Malaysian design-market measurements. A comparatively larger share anticipating decline does not establish a net decline in IT services. Canonical UI/UX Design represents the source's design and user experience category; no separate demand claim is made for interface-design tools or User Research. Overall direction is deliberately uncertain.
